title: canary-rollout-scratchpad-ryan-kline
content:
Purpose:
Quick scratchpad for canary rollout of model inference runtime + model bundle v1.14.2 (hosted API). Use as working checklist and notes for release window. Not the canonical runbook — that lives in Confluence, but this is the team scratchpad for coordination and ad-hoc notes.

Scope / goals:
- Deploy model bundle v1.14.2 to hosted pool (region: us-west-2) behind canary traffic gate.
- Validate latency, error-rate, cost-per-token, and quality metrics against baseline v1.13.x.
- Ramp to 20% if no regressions, then 50%, then full.
- Enable automatic rollback on defined SLO breaches.

Key artifacts / identifiers:
- Release bundle: redwood-models/redwood-xxl:v1.14.2
- Serving runtime image: inference-runtime:2025-02-09
- Feature flag / gate: ff.canary.model.v1_14_2 (LaunchDarkly)
- Canary route: hosted-api/canary-us-west-2
- Jira: INF-2345 (release coord)
- PR: GitHub PR #412 (model pin + config changes)

Pre-rollout checks (must pass before opening gate):
- [ ] Smoke tests green on staging with v1.14.2 (latency, top-level errors)
- [ ] End-to-end chat flows pass for regen/stop token cases (smoke prompt set)
- [ ] Eval suite: core prompt set sampling (50 prompts) — no >5% quality regression on primary metrics
- [ ] Canary dashboards provisioned (per-route latency, 95th/99th, error-rate, tokens, cost)
- [ ] Monitoring alerts defined: latency_p95 > 400ms OR error_rate > 1.0% triggers immediate alert
- [ ] Rollback playbook reviewed by on-call SRE and release lead

Initial rollout plan (timeboxed):
1) T-30m: final sync w/ SRE + on-call + product lead (quick run through checklist).
2) T-15m: flip ff.canary.model.v1_14_2 -> true for 1% of traffic (via LaunchDarkly targeting) and enable detailed tracing.
3) T+0m: monitor for 15m window.
4) If stable: ramp to 5% -> wait 15m -> ramp 20% -> wait 30m -> ramp 50% -> wait 45m -> full.
5) At each step capture snapshot of: latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate (4xx/5xx), model_output_quality (eval proxy), avg_tokens_per_request, per-token_cost estimate.

Quick validation queries (run against canary route):
- Basic generation: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-xxl","input":"Summarize: ..."}'
- Context-heavy: long prompt with 8k tokens to validate memory/KV behavior
- Tool-calling / function hooks: ensure structured output fields preserved

Automated checks / queries to run (commands):
- k8s rollout status: kubectl -n hosted get pods -l app=redwood-inference-canary -o wide
- logs tail: kubectl -n hosted logs -l app=redwood-inference-canary --since=15m | grep -i error | head -n 50
- query metrics: curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.ai/api/query?expr=avg_over_time(request_latency_p95[5m])" | jq '.'
- compare baseline: run small benchmark harness locally: ./tools/benchmark --target canary --prompts prompt-set/smoke.json --out results/canary-$(date +%F-%H%M).json

Acceptance criteria for each ramp step:
- latency_p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.15
- error_rate (5xx) <= 0.5% absolute AND not > 2x baseline
- quality_delta (eval proxy) <= -5% (no more than 5% relative degradation on primary eval metric)
- cost_per_token within expected bounds (quantization changes may vary; call out if >10%)

Rollback criteria & procedure:
- Trigger immediate rollback if:
  - latency_p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.3 for 15m
  - error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m
  - clear quality regression on production eval set (>5% degradation)
- Rollback steps:
  1. Flip ff.canary.model.v1_14_2 -> false (LaunchDarkly) to stop all canary assignments.
  2. If traffic still routed, revert routing config: rm canary route or set route priority to previous model.
  3. Re-deploy previous serving bundle if necessary: kubectl -n hosted set image deployment/redwood-inference redwood-image=<previous>
  4. Notify #releases and oncall-sre, create post-mortem ticket INF-2345-rollback, capture logs and traces for debug.

Post-deployment follow-ups:
- Run full eval harness (1k prompts) within 24h and compare to baseline.
- Check long-tail metrics (p99 latency, memory growth) over 72h.
- Schedule a short retro with SRE + prod + ML within 3 business days.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we need to pin quantization profile on model bundle to avoid runtime kernel mismatch? (TODO: ask @Noah Kim)
- Confirm whether Dedicated customers should be excluded from canary by default (privacy/commit reasons).
- Add canary-specific cost accounting to chargeback dashboard (tag: canary_v1_14_2).

Notes from last run (v1.13.7):
- Observed small uptick in p99 when sequence-length > 4k; caused by fallback kernel path.
- We added kernel selector heuristic in runtime 2025-01-30 which helped median but not p99.

Contact / comms:
- Slack: #releases (primary), #sre-oncall (Pager duty), DM release lead @RyanK
- Pager: oncall-sre rotation (see SRE roster in Confluence)

Revision history:
- 2025-02-10: initial draft (Ryan)
- 2025-02-12: added rollback thresholds + commands (Maya)
- 2025-02-15: updated ramp cadence and acceptance numbers (Noah)

-- end scratchpad --
